arxiv-1711-10684.title: Road Extraction by Deep Residual U-Net
arxiv-1711-10684.creator: Zhengxin Zhang, Qingjie Liu, Yunhong Wang
arxiv-1711-10684.description: Abstract Road extraction from aerial images has been a hot research topic in the field of remote sensing image analysis. In this letter, a semantic segmentation neural network which combines the strengths of residual learning and U-Net is proposed for road area extraction. The network is built with residual units and has similar architecture to that of U-Net.

arxiv-2103-01600.title: Missing Value Imputation on Multidimensional Time Series
arxiv-2103-01600.creator: Parikshit Bansal, Prathamesh Deshpande, Sunita Sarawagi
arxiv-2103-01600.description: Abstract . We present DeepMVI, a deep learning method for missing value imputation in multidimensional time-series datasets. Missing values are commonplace in decision support platforms that aggregate data over long time stretches from disparate sources, whereas reliable data analytics calls for careful handling of missing data.

arxiv-2110-05811.title: Geometry effects in topologically confined bilayer graphene loops
arxiv-2110-05811.creator: Nassima Benchtaber, David Sánchez, Llorenç Serra
arxiv-2110-05811.description: Abstract We investigate the electronic confinement in bilayer graphene by topological loops of different shapes. These loops are created by lateral gates acting via gap inversion on the two graphene sheets. For large-area loops the spectrum is well described by a quantization rule depending only on the loop perimeter. For small sizes, the spectrum depends on the loop shape.

arxiv-2303-10068.title: Proactive Rumor Control: When Impression Counts (Full Version)
arxiv-2303-10068.creator: Pengfei Xu, Zhiyong Peng, Liwei Wang
arxiv-2303-10068.description: Abstract The spread of rumors in online networks threatens public safety and results in economic losses. To overcome this problem, a lot of work studies the problem of rumor control which aims at limiting the spread of rumors. However, all previous work ignores the relationship between the influence block effect and counts of impressions on the user.

arxiv-2308-06877.title: Autocalibration of the E3SM Version 2 Atmosphere Model Using a PCA-Based Surrogate for Spatial Fields Thanks: corresponding author,bmwagma@sandia.gov
arxiv-2308-06877.creator: Drew Yarger, Benjamin Wagman, Lyndsay Shand, Kenny Chowdhary
arxiv-2308-06877.description: Abstract Global Climate Model (GCM) tuning (calibration) is a tedious and time-consuming process, with high-dimensional input and output fields. Experts typically tune by iteratively running climate simulations with hand-picked values of tuning parameters. Many, in both the statistical and climate literature, have proposed alternative calibration methods, but most are impractical or difficult to implement.

arxiv-2310-15618.title: Estimating the dimension of the Thurston Spine
arxiv-2310-15618.creator: Olivier Mathieu
arxiv-2310-15618.description: Abstract . For g ≥ 2 g\geq 2 , the Thurston spine 𝒫 g \mathcal{P}_{g} is the subspace of Teichmüller space 𝒯 g \mathcal{T}_{g} , consisting of the marked surfaces for which the set of shortest curves, the systoles, cuts the surface into polygons.

arxiv-2312-12172.title: Reassessing the advantage of indefinite causal orders for quantum metrology Institute of Engineering Univ. Grenoble Alpes Institute of Engineering Univ. Grenoble Alpes
arxiv-2312-12172.creator: Raphaël Mothe, Cyril Branciard, Alastair A. Abbott
arxiv-2312-12172.description: Abstract The quantum switch, the canonical example of a process with indefinite causal order, has been claimed to provide various advantages over processes with definite causal orders for some particular tasks in the field of quantum metrology. In this work, we argue that some of these advantages in fact do not hold if a fairer comparison is made.

arxiv-2402-11700.title: Why Lift so Heavy? Slimming Large Language Models by Cutting Off the Layers
arxiv-2402-11700.creator: Shuzhou Yuan, Ercong Nie, Bolei Ma, Michael Färber
arxiv-2402-11700.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate exceptional language understanding and generation capabilities by learning from context. Leveraging the strong in-context learning (ICL) abilities of LLMs, prompt-based fine-tuning has proven to be effective for enhancing the adaptability and alignment of LLMs, especially in low-data scenarios.

arxiv-2505-12794.title: Evidence that Mass Loss on the Red Giant Branch Decreases with Metallicity
arxiv-2505-12794.creator: Yaguang Li (李亚光)
arxiv-2505-12794.description: Abstract Mass loss on the red giant branch (RGB) influences stellar evolution, properties of stellar populations, and Galactic chemical enrichment, yet remains poorly constrained observationally. Current models provide limited insight into how stellar properties, particularly how metallicity and mass, affect RGB mass loss.

arxiv-2506-05663.title: Insights from Designing Context-Aware Meal Preparation Assistance for Older Adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) and Their Care Partners Conference: Designing Interactive Systems Conference; July 5–9, 2025; Funchal, Portugal Designing Interactive Systems Conference (DIS ’25), July 5–9, 2025,
arxiv-2506-05663.creator: Szeyi Chan, Jiachen Li, Siman Ao, Yufei Wang, Ibrahim Bilau, Brian Jones, Eunhwa Yang, Elizabeth D Mynatt, Xiang Zhi Tan
arxiv-2506-05663.description: Abstract . Older adults with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) often face challenges during meal preparation, such as forgetting ingredients, skipping steps, or leaving appliances on, which can compromise their safety and independence. Our study explores the design of context-aware assistive technologies for meal preparation using a user-centered iterative design process.

arxiv-2509-12000.title: Results of the 2025 Video Browser Showdown
arxiv-2509-12000.creator: Luca Rossetto, Klaus Schoeffmann, Cathal Gurrin, Jakub Lokoč, Werner Bailer
arxiv-2509-12000.description: Abstract This report presents the results of the 14 th Video Browser Showdown, held at the 2025 International Conference on Multimedia Modeling on the 8 th of January 2025 in Nara, Japan. arxiv-2512-01862.title: Hierarchies of Beliefs and Measurable Uniformizations Thanks: Acknowledgments We’d like to thank Adam Brandenburger for many illuminating discussions about Game Theory. We also thank Hugh Woodin and Paul Larson for helpful comments.
arxiv-2512-01862.creator: Stuart Zoble December 1, 2025
arxiv-2512-01862.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Stuart Zoble December 1, 2025. We extend the Fundamental Theorem of Epistemic Game Theory to games with Baire class one payoffs and locally compact Polish strategy spaces, and under Projective Determinacy, to games with analytically measurable payoffs and arbitrary Polish strategy spaces.

arxiv-2601-05700.title: Existence of nontrival n n -harmonic maps via min-max methods
arxiv-2601-05700.creator: Dorian Martino, Katarzyna Mazowiecka, Armin Schikorra
arxiv-2601-05700.description: Abstract . For any n ≥ 3 n\geq 3 and any closed manifold 𝒩 {\mathcal{N}} with π n + k ​ ( 𝒩 ) ≠ { 0 } \pi_{n+k}({\mathcal{N}})\neq\{0\} for some k ≥ 0 k\geq 0 , we establish the existence of nontrivial n n -harmonic maps from 𝕊 n {\mathbb{S}}^{n} into 𝒩 {\mathcal{N}} .

arxiv-2602-14200.title: TS-Haystack: A Multi-Scale Retrieval Benchmark for Time Series Language Models
arxiv-2602-14200.creator: Nicolas Zumarraga, Thomas Kaar, Ning Wang, Maxwell A. Xu, Max Rosenblattl, Markus Kreft Kevin O’Sullivan Paul Schmiedmayer Patrick Langer Robert Jakob, [6pt] Agentic Systems Lab, ETH Zurich
arxiv-2602-14200.description: Abstract Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) are emerging as unified models for reasoning over continuous signals in natural language. However, long-context retrieval remains a major limitation: existing models are typically trained and evaluated on short sequences, while real-world time-series sensor streams can span millions of datapoints.

arxiv-2606-16934.title: Exploring Extrinsic and Intrinsic Properties for Effective Reasoning with Code Interpreter
arxiv-2606-16934.creator: Patomporn Payoungkhamdee patomporn.p_s21@vistec.ac.th, Napat Laosaengpha napat.r@vistec.ac.th, Jenta Wonglertsakul jenta.w@live.ku.th, Pittawat Taveekitworachai pittawat@scb10x.com, Pume Tuchinda pumet_pro@vistec.ac.th, Panjapong Poobanchuen panjapong.pooba@kmutt.ac.th, Ekapol Chuangsuwanich ekapol.c@chula.ac.th, Can Udomcharoenchaikit canu_pro@vistec.ac.th, Samuel Cahyawijaya samuelcahyawijaya@cohere.com, Peerat Limkonchotiwat peerat@aisingapore.org, Sarana Nutanong snutanon@vistec.ac.th

europmc-pmc6422571.description: Background Reliability studies are commonly used in questionnaire development studies and questionnaire validation studies. This study reviews the sample size guideline for Cronbach's alpha test. Methods Manual sample size calculation using Microsoft Excel software and sample si

plos-pone-0001646.creator: Kenichi Horisawa, Nobuhide Doi, Hiroshi Yanagawa
plos-pone-0001646.description: PLOS ONE research article. In vitro display technologies such as mRNA display are powerful screening tools for protein interaction analysis, but the final cloning and sequencing processes represent a bottleneck, resulting in many false negatives. Here we describe an application of tiling array technology t

pmc-11565228.title: Origin of sulfate in post-snowball-Earth oceans: river inputs vs. shelf-derived H2S
pmc-11565228.creator: Huiming Bao, Yongbo Peng, Xiaobin Cao
pmc-11565228.description: A synthesis of global barite sulfate isotope data from approximately 635 million years ago, at the end of a global glaciation, undermines the hypothesis that river sulfate was the primary carrier of the distinctive 17O-depleted atmospheric O2 signature of the time.

pmc-12468511.title: Metabolic Engineering of Terpenoid Biosynthesis in Medicinal Plants: From Genomic Insights to Biotechnological Applications
pmc-12468511.creator: Changfeng Guo, Si Xu, Xiaoyun Guo, Violeta Popovici
pmc-12468511.description: Terpenoids, which are essential pharmaceutical compounds, encounter significant production challenges due to their low yields in native plants and associated ecological concerns. This review summarizes recent advances in metabolic engineering strategies applied across three complementary platforms: native medicinal plants, microbial systems, and heterologous plant hosts.

pmc-12517284.title: Antimicrobial activity of Andrographis paniculata intimate wash and commercial formulations against vaginal pathogens using the broth microdilution method
pmc-12517284.creator: Nur Rina Alissa Razian, Tuan Noorkorina Tuan Kub, Nurdini Afiqah Suhaimi, Tuan Nadrah Naim Tuan Ismail, Muhamad Alojid Anis Amiera, Gayus Sale Dafur, Fatmawati Lambuk, Rohimah Mohamud, Ramlah Kadir, Norzila Ismail, Norhayati Yusop
pmc-12517284.description: BackgroundThis study aims to evaluate the antimicrobial efficacy of a newly formulated Andrographis paniculata intimate wash in comparison with commercial brands (SebaMed®, Sumber Ayu, Lactacyd®, and Good Virtue & Co.) against vaginal pathogens. The antimicrobial activity of each formulation was tested against Streptococcus agalactiae, Escherichia coli, and Candida albicans.

pmc-12532436.title: Household health-seeking behaviour and response to Informal payment: does economic status matter?
pmc-12532436.creator: Chukwudi Nwokolo, Obinna Onwujekwe, Martin McKee, Iheomimichineke Ojiakor, Blake Angell, Dina Balabanova
pmc-12532436.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionCorruption is a major factor that influences health seeking behaviour. However, there is paucity of empirical evidence from research on how corruption affects different population groups when they seek healthcare services from formal healthcare facilities.

pmc-12535240.title: A Systematic Review of Population Pharmacokinetics, Safety, and Factors Influencing Trough Concentrations of Voriconazole in Asian Patients with Liver Dysfunction
pmc-12535240.creator: Lin Hu, Changyu Wang, Shiqiong Huang, Xi Tang, Yanfei Li
pmc-12535240.description: ObjectiveThis study systematically reviews recent research on voriconazole (VRC) use in Asian patients with liver dysfunction to provide a scientific basis for individualized therapy.MethodsA comprehensive literature search was conducted in EMBASE, PubMed, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library for clinical studies on VRC use in Asian patients with liver dysfunction, published between January 1, 2000, and March 1, 2025.

pmc-12650680.title: An Improved Black-Winged Kite Algorithm for Global Optimization and Fault Detection
pmc-12650680.creator: Kun Qi, Kai Wei, Rong Cheng, Guangmin Liang, Jiashun Hu, Wangyu Wu
pmc-12650680.description: In the field of industrial fault detection, accurate and timely fault identification is crucial for ensuring production safety and efficiency. Effective feature selection (FS) methods can significantly enhance detection performance in this process. However, the recently proposed Black-winged Kite Algorithm (BKA) tends to suffer from premature convergence and local optima when handling high-dimensional feature spaces.

pmc-12651412.title: Research on Image Encryption with Multi-Level Keys Based on a Six-Dimensional Memristive Chaotic System
pmc-12651412.creator: Xiaobin Zhang, Yaxuan Chai, Shitao Xiang, Shaozhen Li, Boris Ryabko
pmc-12651412.description: To address the security of digital images, this paper proposes a novel image encryption algorithm based on a six-dimensional memristive chaotic system. First, the algorithm uses the Secure Hash Algorithm 256 (SHA-256) to generate a hash value, from which the initial dynamic key is derived.

pmc-13050513.title: Decision Support Tools Strengthen Early Peanut Introduction Practices and Streamline Data Automation
pmc-13050513.creator: Lauren E Herlihy, Cristina Collins, Kelly Reilly, Elizabeth Blyth, Laura Gay, Priyanka Rao, Meaghan Sowers, Katherine Jordan
pmc-13050513.description: Objective: Peanut allergy prevalence in children persists in the United States. Early peanut introduction (EPI) is now recognized as an evidence-based guideline for preventing peanut allergy. EPI implementation relies on primary care providers (PCPs) guiding caregivers of young infants as they transition to solid foods.

pmc-13245737.title: CRISPR-MBTF: a multi-branch transformer fusion framework for CRISPR-Cas9 off-target prediction
pmc-13245737.creator: Ali Jahangiri-Sisakht, Leila Safari, Roghayyeh Alipanahi
pmc-13245737.description: Clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats and CRISPR-associated protein 9 (CRISPR-Cas9) is a revolutionary genome editing technology derived from a bacterial adaptive immune system that uses a single guide RNA (sgRNA) to direct the Cas9 enzyme to specific DNA sequences for precise genetic modifications. Its ease of use and efficiency has accelerated advancements in genetic research and therapeutic development.

pmc-13346029.title: A review of robotic-assisted mediastinal surgery in the pediatric population
pmc-13346029.creator: John F Shepherd, Caroline W Maloney, Paul L Linsky

pmc-13573320.title: Faculty professional development and career advancement through Student Evaluations of Teaching (SETs)
pmc-13573320.creator: Maria Zulema Cabail, Roslyn N. Crowder, Maitreyi Das, Verónica A. Segarra
pmc-13573320.description: New faculty members starting to develop their pedagogy often realize quickly that student evaluations of teaching (SETs) are essential components of a faculty member’s progression through the academic ranks. The degree to which these evaluations influence one’s advancement up the academic ladder varies depending on the type of institution.

pmc-13576833.title: Modeling Multiscale Architecture of Biofilm Extracellular Matrix and Its Role in Oxygen Transport
pmc-13576833.creator: Raghu K. Moorthy, Eoin Casey
pmc-13576833.description: The extracellular polymeric substances (EPS) matrix of microbial biofilms exhibits a complex structural heterogeneity that profoundly influences mass transport and metabolic activity. Conventional biofilm models typically assume a homogeneous matrix, thereby neglecting the localized transport resistance introduced by the bacterial capsule, a distinct, low‐diffusivity polysaccharide layer surrounding individual cells.

pmc-13623917.title: Communication delay increases procedure time and instructor task load during simulated suturing by novices
pmc-13623917.creator: Albert Yeam, Khushi Bhatt, Katherine Hanna, Tovy Haber Kamine, Ariana M Nelson

pmc-13678900.title: Knowledge, attitudes, and practices of Sudanese medical professionals regarding the 2023 Sudan malaria treatment protocol: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13678900.creator: Yousif Omer Elgaili Yousif, Rayan Mohamed Issa Kheerallah, Maab Khalifa Mohamed Ahmed, Khadiga Mansoor Ali Bakheit, Azza Omer Osman Abdelrahman, Hind Elmukashfi ShamsEldin Elobied, Sittia Basil Hassan Ali, Srraa Abdelrasoul Elnour Ismail, Sahl Muawia Elbsri Elshaikh, Tarik Abdulrahim Ahmed Yousif, A
pmc-13678900.description: IntroductionMalaria remains a major public health challenge in Sudan, primarily driven by Plasmodium falciparum. Timely and effective case management is critical, necessitating high adherence to the newly issued Sudan Malaria Case Management Protocol 2023. This study aimed to assess the knowledge, attitudes, and current practices of Sudanese medical professionals regarding this 2023 protocol.
